chose: A reach is owed when a story's first design would add a new kind of record and its store, an editor, player, recorder or annotation layer, a sync, sharing or import path, a new deployable or service, or more than one PR before first use. It is not owed for changes to an existing surface, or for a story whose point is building the machinery. It comes before the first PR of the machinery and ends in a call whose options are the tools and building, named under 'Reach' in the epic's body. Review raises a missing reach as a non-blocking finding.
options: threshold by kind of machinery, non-blocking review finding
a size threshold (lines or PR count) only
a blocking review finding or a check
gray: #3291 asks Claude to propose the threshold; the owner would feel it in which stories stop for a reach first.
